name: Decision Graphs
description: Explicit representations of judgment that make reasoning inspectable, reusable, and improvable over time.

name: Knowledge Compilation
description: Transforming heterogeneous human knowledge into structured, navigable semantic artifacts — organized before the question is asked.

name: Compile-Time AI
description: Performing reasoning once and compiling it into representations people can explore, instead of rediscovering relationships on every query.

name: Cognitive Memory
description: Persistent, structured memory that compounds understanding across sessions instead of forgetting it between conversations.

name: Knowledge Representation
description: How understanding is modeled, structured, and made explicit — from decision graphs to intermediate representations.

name: Research Automation
description: Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents that ingest, synthesize, and broadcast knowledge — returning time to human discovery and care.

name: Local-First AI
description: Knowledge systems that run on your own hardware — transparent, inspectable, and under the user’s control rather than a third party’s cloud.

name: Scientific Knowledge Systems
description: Semantic infrastructure for preserving scientific knowledge, accelerating discovery, and making research easier to build upon.
